title: Experimental Analysis of Productive Interaction Strategy with ChatGPT: User Study on Function and Project-level Code Generation Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2508.04125v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The application of Large Language Models (LLMs) is growing in the productive completion of Software Engineering tasks. Yet, studies investigating productive prompting techniques often employed a limited problem space, focusing primarily on well-known prompting patterns and targeting function-level SE practices. We identify significant gaps in real-world workflows that involve complexities beyond class-level (e.g., multi-class dependencies) and different features that can impact Human-LLM Interaction (HLI) processes in code generation. To address these issues, we designed an experiment to comprehensively analyze HLI features related to code generation productivity. Our study presents two project-level benchmark tasks that extend beyond function-level evaluations. translated_title: 与ChatGPT高效交互策略的实验分析：关于函数级与项目级代码生成任务的用户研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在软件工程任务的高效完成中的应用日益增长。然而，研究高效提示技术的现有工作往往局限于有限的问题空间，主要聚焦于知名的提示模式，且针对的是函数级的软件工程实践。我们发现了现实工作流程中存在的显著差距，这些工作流程涉及超出类级别的复杂性（例如多类依赖关系），以及可能影响代码生成中人机交互（HLI）过程的各种特性。为了解决这些问题，我们设计了一个实验，全面分析与代码生成生产力相关的HLI特性。我们的研究提出了两个超越函数级评估范围的项目级基准任务。我们开展了一项包含36名不同背景参与者的用户研究，要求他们通过与GPT助手进行特定交互的方式来完成分配的任务。
tldr: 该研究通过36名不同背景参与者的用户实验，在两个项目级基准任务上全面分析了人与ChatGPT的交互特性对代码生成生产力的影响，弥补了以往研究仅关注函数级任务和常见提示模式的不足。
en_tdlr: This study conducts a user study with 36 participants on two project-level benchmark tasks to comprehensively analyze how Human-LLM Interaction features affect code generation productivity with ChatGPT, addressing gaps in prior work limited to function-level tasks and well-known prompting patterns.
